topic.title: Imitation Learning from Limited and Imperfect Demonstrations
topic.overview: Imitation learning turns demonstrations into policies, but examples may omit actions, contain suboptimal decisions, or cover only a narrow region of the environment. This topic studies how to extract goals, dynamics, and confidence from such data. Planning and inverse-dynamics components can separate where an expert intends to go from the actions needed to get there.
topic.whyItMatters: Small mistakes can move a cloned policy outside the demonstrated states, causing errors to compound. A useful imitation system needs ways to recover, transfer across dynamics, and distinguish reliable guidance from flawed behavior.
topic.evolution: Early representatives frame goals and imitation probabilistically. Later work adds state-only learning, confidence estimates, and preferences. The 2022–2026 examples use backward rollouts for recovery, decoupled planners for transfer, and bias–variance analysis to explain when predictive inverse dynamics needs fewer demonstrations than direct behavior cloning.
openQuestions: How can imitation detect that a demonstration is systematically wrong?
When do learned dynamics improve recovery rather than amplify model error?

papers.title: Domain Adaptive Imitation Learning with Visual Observation

papers.title: Hybrid Policy Optimization from Imperfect Demonstrations

papers.title: Learning Shared Safety Constraints from Multi-task Demonstrations

papers.title: Multi-Modal Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning from a Mixture of Demonstrations

papers.title: Offline Imitation Learning with Variational Counterfactual Reasoning

papers.title: Regularized Behavior Cloning for Blocking the Leakage of Past Action Information

papers.title: Residual Q-Learning: Offline and Online Policy Customization without Value

papers.title: SafeDICE: Offline Safe Imitation Learning with Non-Preferred Demonstrations

papers.title: Selective Sampling and Imitation Learning via Online Regression

papers.title: Social Motion Prediction with Cognitive Hierarchies

papers.title: Thought Cloning: Learning to Think while Acting by Imitating Human Thinking

papers.title: Confidence Aware Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Diffusion Model-Augmented Behavioral Cloning

papers.title: Environment Design for Inverse Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: EvIL: Evolution Strategies for Generalisable Imitation Learning

papers.title: How to Leverage Diverse Demonstrations in Offline Imitation Learning

papers.title: Iterative Regularized Policy Optimization with Imperfect Demonstrations

papers.title: Adversarial Moment-Matching Distillation of Large Language Models

papers.title: AED: Adaptable Error Detection for Few-shot Imitation Policy

papers.title: C-GAIL: Stabilizing Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning with Control Theory

papers.title: Causal Imitation for Markov Decision Processes: a Partial Identification Approach
